description: This file contains core functionality, value objects, and processor classes for collecting and managing summary counts of test runs in the behave testing framework. It defines classes for status counts, hook error counts, and a summary collector that processes features, scenarios, rules, and steps.

classes.name: StatusCounts
classes.description: Counter subclass that tracks counts of different statuses for features, rules, scenarios, and steps.

classes.name: HookErrorCounts
classes.description: Counter subclass for tracking hook failure and error counts at different levels.

classes.name: SummaryCounts
classes.description: Composite object aggregating StatusCounts and HookErrorCounts for features, rules, scenarios, steps, and hook errors.

classes.name: SummaryCollector
classes.description: Visitor class that collects summary counts from behave features, scenarios, rules, and steps during test execution.
